name: Normal Traffic
description: Baseline operational traffic at 800 req/s. All services operate safely within capacity, no bottlenecks or dropped requests.

name: Traffic Spike
description: Sudden surge to 2,500 req/s. Offered load pushes the API Gateway, Agent Service, and Billing Service near and beyond their operational thresholds.

name: Session Cache Pressure
description: Downscaled Redis capacity (1 worker @ 600 req/s), creating a primary cache bottleneck during session validation.

name: Flash Sale
description: Massive promotional event with 4,000 req/s. Multiple tiers (Gateway, Agent, Chat, Billing) become heavily overloaded with growing queues and rejected requests.

name: Scale-Out Fleet
description: Same 4,000 req/s flash sale load, but with scaled-out horizontal worker pools across Gateway, Services, and Session Cache to demonstrate bottleneck resolution.
